prompt: In our core-infra channel, Priya posted the message confirming the CUDA memory limit was the real root cause of the OOM issue. Lukas left a reaction on that message — please remove it.
binding_note: The reaction is identified by walking REACTION→USER (Lukas as reactor) →MESSAGE (Priya's CUDA-limit confirmation)→CONVERSATION (core-infra)→WORKSPACE (Test Workspace); the emoji itself is not named in the prompt so it must be discovered via the conversation/reaction records.

roles.facts: Agent bot U01AGENBOT9, member of core-infra and other channels in T01WORKSPACE.
roles.reason: Acting user issuing the removal request.

roles.facts: U_LUKAS, Łukasz Kowalski, member of core-infra (C_INFRA) and other engineering channels.
roles.reason: The user whose reaction must be removed, per the USER hop.

roles.facts: Same user U_LUKAS, but this record is his reaction on a different, non-matching message.
roles.reason: Same person tested against a wrong message hop.

roles.facts: Same user U_LUKAS, reaction on a message located in a different conversation (model-research).
roles.reason: Tests that the conversation hop must match core-infra.

roles.facts: Same user U_LUKAS, reacting to his own posted message in core-infra rather than to Priya's message.
roles.reason: Tests message authorship condition (must be Priya's message, not Lukas's own).

roles.facts: U_OLENA, Olena Petrenko, also a member of core-infra, reacted on the exact same target message.
roles.reason: Tests that the reactor must be Lukas, not another member reacting to the correct message.

roles.facts: message_id 1706001931.000000, channel_id C_INFRA, user_id U_PRIYA, text confirms the batch-size increase hit a hard CUDA memory limit (root cause of the OOM incident).
roles.reason: This is the message Priya posted confirming the CUDA memory limit finding — the MESSAGE hop anchor.

roles.facts: message_id 1706000208.000000, channel_id C_INFRA, user_id U_PRIYA, an earlier alert about OOM kills — same channel/author but not the confirmation message.
roles.reason: Distractor sharing channel and author but not the identifying content/role of confirming the root cause.

roles.facts: message_id 1706012456.000000, channel_id C_MODEL, user_id U_SOPHIE, about the new 7B checkpoint — unrelated topic in a different conversation.
roles.reason: Used to construct the wrong-channel reaction negative.

roles.facts: message_id 1706069700.000001, channel_id C_INFRA, user_id U_LUKAS, about treating the GPU cluster like a supercomputer for scheduling.
roles.reason: Same channel, but authored by Lukas himself rather than Priya — breaks the required authorship link.

roles.facts: C_INFRA, channel_name core-infra, team_id T01WORKSPACE, public, not archived; members include Lukas, Priya, Olena, and the actor.
roles.reason: The CONVERSATION hop that must contain the target message.

roles.facts: C_MODEL, channel_name model-research, team_id T01WORKSPACE; also contains Lukas as a member.
roles.reason: A different conversation that also contains Lukas, used to build the wrong-channel negative reaction.

roles.facts: T01WORKSPACE, Test Workspace, containing core-infra and model-research among other channels.
roles.reason: The WORKSPACE terminal node bounding the whole route.

roles.facts: message_id 1706001931.000000, user_id U_LUKAS, reaction_type raised_hands, created_at set shortly after the message.
roles.reason: The single reaction record satisfying all route hops: Lukas's reaction on Priya's CUDA-limit confirmation message in core-infra.

roles.facts: message_id 1706000208.000000, user_id U_LUKAS, reaction_type eyes — Lukas reacting to the earlier alert message, not the confirmation.
roles.reason: Fails the MESSAGE hop condition even though user and channel match.

roles.facts: message_id 1706001931.000000, user_id U_OLENA, reaction_type raised_hands — Olena reacting on the correct message.
roles.reason: Fails the USER hop condition even though the message matches exactly.

roles.facts: message_id 1706012456.000000, user_id U_LUKAS, reaction_type raised_hands — Lukas reacting to Sophie's checkpoint message in model-research.
roles.reason: Fails the CONVERSATION hop even though the user and emoji match.

roles.facts: message_id 1706069700.000001, user_id U_LUKAS, reaction_type raised_hands — Lukas reacting to his own message in core-infra.
roles.reason: Same channel and user, but the message's author does not satisfy the required 'Priya's confirmation' condition.

obligations.name: remove_target_reaction
obligations.description: Select the single reaction that Lukas (the reactor) added to the message Priya authored in core-infra confirming the CUDA memory limit root cause, then remove that reaction.
obligations.scope: the identified reaction on the identified message within the core-infra channel of the Test Workspace

task_spec.text: Identify the message Priya posted in core-infra confirming the CUDA memory limit as the root cause, find Lukas's reaction on it, and remove that reaction.

access_plan: Use conversations.history on the core-infra channel (C_INFRA) to locate Priya's message confirming the CUDA memory limit as the root cause; use reactions.get on that message's timestamp/channel to enumerate its reactions and find the one contributed by Lukas; then call reactions.remove with that channel, timestamp, and emoji name.
